title: August 11 edits
summary: On behalf of @atlas-axis , we are submitting the Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle proposal below. This proposal includes the following edits: Rename Star Agents To Prime Agents - Renames Star Agents to Prime Agents to prepare for the introduction of Halo Agents. Rename Prime Delegates To Ranked Delegates - Renames Prime Delegates to Ranked Delegates to avoid potential confusion given the introduction of Prime Agents. Update Ethena Risk Capital Requirements - Updates the near-term Required Risk Capital for Ethena exposures. Refine Risk Requirements For Real World Assets - Refines the Risk Framework requirements for investments in JTRSY and JAAA. Clarify Operator Of Spark Liquidity Layer - Clarifies that Spark has overall responsibility for the operation of the Spark Liquidity Layer. Remove Logic For DDM Vaults From Sky Core Atlas - Removes logic for the deprecated Morpho Dai DDM Vault from the Sky Core Atlas. Use Consistent Terminology For Administrative Risk - Updates references to “Admin Risk” to “Administrative Risk” for consistency. Make Follow Up Changes From August 4th Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal - Updates terminology used in the Simplified Profit And Loss Calculation and clarifies the assets that qualify as Resting versus Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral. Rename Star Agents To Prime Agents Update the term Stars with Primes as specified in the linked Pull Request: https://github.com/sky-ecosystem/next-gen-atlas/pull/39 Rename Prime Delegates To Ranked Delegates Update the term Prime Delegates with Ranked Delegates as specified in the linked Pull Request: https://github.com/sky-ecosystem/next-gen-atlas/pull/40 Update Ethena Risk Capital Requirements Add a new subdocument of A.3.3.1.1.2 - Instance Total RRC (Portal) / A.3.3 - Instance Total RRC (GitHub) . This document should be located directly after A.3.3.1.1.2.1 - Application To Real World Assets (Portal) / A.3.3 - Application To Real World Assets (GitHub) and its subdocuments and before A.3.3.1.1.2.2 - Incorporation Of Additional Types Of RRC (Portal) / A.3.3 - Incorporation Of Additional Types Of RRC (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.3 - Application To Ethena (Core) - In the short term, direct Ethena exposures automatically have Instance Smart Contract RRC and Instance Administrative RRC of zero. In the long term, given the similarity of these assets to Real World Assets, adapted frameworks for Smart Contract Risk and Administrative Risk for these exposures must be developed. See A.3.3 - Long Term Application To Real World Assets . Replace A.3.3.1.1.3.3.2.1.1 - Near-Term Treatment (Portal) / A.3.3 - Near-Term Treatment (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.3 - Near-Term Treatment (Core) - In the near term pending development of the implementation of the model for perpetual positions, the following Instance Financial RRC Ratios will apply: Direct Ethena exposure - 2% Instance Financial RRC Ratio Indirect Ethena exposure through lending markets - 3% Instance Financial RRC Ratio For indirect Ethena exposure through lending markets, only the portion of the exposure to the lending market that is backed by Ethena-related assets (including PT-USDe, PT-sUSDe, and PT-eUSDe) is subject to the Instance Financial RRC Ratio specified above. The Instance Financial RRC Ratio for the remaining portion of the exposure is calculated based on the nature of the assets backing the exposure. Refine Risk Requirements For Real World Assets Replace A.3.3.1.1.2.1.1 - Short Term Application To Real World Asset (Portal) / A.3.3 - Short Term Application To Real World Assets (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.3 - Short Term Application To Real World Assets (Core) - In the short term, investments in the following Real World Assets automatically have Instance Smart Contract RRC and Instance Administrative RRC of zero: BUIDL JTRSY through Centrifuge v2 USTB JAAA through Centrifuge v2 JTRSY and JAAA through Centrifuge v3 once audits have been approved by the Protocol Security Workstream Lead All other investments in RWAs have Instance Total RRC of 100%. Replace A.3.3.1.1.3.3.2.4.1 - Near-Term Treatment (Portal) / A.3.3 - Near-Term Treatment (GitHub) and its subdocument to read as follows: A.3.3 - Near-Term Treatment (Core) - In the near term pending development of the implementation of the model for Real World Assets, the following Instance Financial RRC Ratios will apply: BUIDL, JTRSY on Ethereum Mainnet, and USTB - 0% Instance Financial RRC Ratio JTRSY on Avalanche - 0.5% Instance Financial RRC Ratio JAAA on Ethereum Mainnet - 1.6% Instance Financial RRC Ratio JAAA on Avalanche - 2.1% Instance Financial RRC Ratio In the near term, only the assets specified in A.3.3 - Short Term Application To Real World Assets will be eligible for investment under this provision. All other investments in Real World Assets have a 100% Instance Total RRC as specified in the document cited above. A.3.3 - Additional Restrictions On Investments In JTRSY And JAAA On Avalanche (Core) - Investments in JTRSY and JAAA on Avalanche are subject to the following additional restrictions: The initial deployment of capital into JTRSY and JAAA on Avalanche may not exceed 20 million USDS in total; Each additional deployment of capital into JTRSY or JAAA must be approved by the Stability Scope Advisors; Until audits of Centrifuge v3 are approved by the Protocol Security Workstream Lead, the Prime must be below a 90% Risk Tolerance Ratio on a pro forma basis assuming that each additional deployment of capital into JTRSY and JAAA requires 100% Instance Total RRC; and Total investments in JTRSY and JAAA on Avalanche may not exceed 250 million USDS. Clarify Operator Of Spark Liquidity Layer Replace the subdocuments of A.AG1.2.6.P15.2.1.3 - Total Risk Capital (TRC) Management (Portal) / Spark - Total Risk Capital (TRC) Management (GitHub) to read as follows: Spark’s Operation Of Spark Liquidity Layer And Agreement Regarding Risk Tolerance Ratio - Spark will continue to operate the Spark Liquidity Layer and agrees to stay at or below a 90% Risk Tolerance Ratio. See A.3.3 - Risk Tolerance Ratio . Spark’s Total Risk Capital (TRC) Management Processes - As operators of the Spark Liquidity Layer, Spark automatically inherits, and is subject to, the base class of operational requirements related to Total Risk Capital management defined in A.2.4 - Primes’ Total Risk Capital (TRC) Management . Modifications to the base operational logic automatically propagate to the Spark Artifact. Remove Logic For DDM Vaults From Sky Core Atlas Delete A.3.5.5.3 - Morpho Vaults (Portal) / A.3.5 - Real World Assets - Perpetual Yield Strategies - Morpho Vaults (GitHub) and its subdocuments. Use Consistent Terminology For Administrative Risk Update the terms admin risk with administrative risk and admin rrc with administrative rrc as specified in the linked Pull Request: https://github.com/sky-ecosystem/next-gen-atlas/pull/41 Make Follow Up Changes From August 4th Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal Replace A.2.5.1.2.1.1.2.2.1.1 - Instance Expense (Portal) / A.2.6 - Sky Core Monthly Settlement Cycle - Monthly Settlement Cycle Overview - Implementation - Stage 1 - Stage 1 Simplified Profit And Loss Calculation - Amount Due From Stars To Sky With Respect To Supply Side Primitives - Step 2: Calculate Total Allocation System Profit - Instance Profit - Instance Expense (GitHub) to read as follows: A.2.6 - Instance Expense (Core) - Instance Expense for an Allocation System Instance for a month is the interest expense on the funds from Sky’s Collateral Portfolio invested in the Instance. It is calculated on a per block basis based on the amount invested from Sky’s Collateral Portfolio and the Agent Credit Line Borrow Rate. Replace A.2.5.1.2.1.1.2.3.1 - Distortion Penalty (Portal) / A.2.6 - Sky Core Monthly Settlement Cycle - Monthly Settlement Cycle Overview - Implementation - Stage 1 - Stage 1 Simplified Profit And Loss Calculation - Amount Due From Stars To Sky With Respect To Supply Side Primitives - Step 3: Calculate Adjusted Allocation System Profit - Distortion Penalty (GitHub) to read as follows: A.2.6 - Distortion Penalty (Core) - The Distortion Penalty is a discretionary penalty designed to mitigate the potential misalignment caused by the asymmetric nature of the Simplified Profit And Loss Calculation, where Primes earn profits on Allocation System Instances that earn more than the Agent Credit Line Borrow Rate but do not suffer losses when Instances earn less than the Agent Credit Line Borrow Rate. The Core Executor Agent, in consultation with the Stability Facilitators and the Stability Scope Advisors, may assess a penalty of up to 100% of Total Allocation System Profit (see A.2.6 - Step 2: Calculate Total Allocation System Profit ) if it determines that a Prime’s decisions were distorted by this incentive structure. Replace A.2.5.1.2.1.1.2.3.2.1.1 - Low Yield Actively Stabilizing Collateral (Portal) / A.2.6 - Sky Core Monthly Settlement Cycle - Monthly Settlement Cycle Overview - Implementation - Stage 1 - Stage 1 Simplified Profit And Loss Calculation - Amount Due From Stars To Sky With Respect To Supply Side Primitives - Step 3: Calculate Adjusted Allocation System Profit - Low Yield Actively Stabilizing Collateral Penalty - Excess Low Yield Actively Stabilizing Collateral Percentage - Low Yield Actively Stabilizing Collateral (GitHub) to read as follows: A.2.6 - Low Yield Actively Stabilizing Collateral (Core) - Low Yield Actively Stabilizing Collateral is Actively Stabilizing Collateral (see A.3.4 - Actively Stabilizing Collateral ) that earns less than the Agent Credit Line Borrow Rate. Replace A.3.4.2.2.1.1.1 - Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations (Portal) / A.3.4 - Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.4 - Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations (Core) - Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral is currently calculated as the sum of: USDC in the LitePSM; USDC in the PSM3 on Base, Arbitrum, Unichain, Optimism; USDT in USDT/USDS Curve pool; USDC in GUNI 0.01%; and USDC in GUNI 0.05%. Replace A.3.4.2.2.1.2.1 - Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations (Portal) / A.3.4 - Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.4 - Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations (Core) - Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral is currently calculated as the sum of: USDC and USDT in Curve (not paired with USDS); USDC and USDT in Uniswap; USDC and USDT in SparkLend; USDC and USDT in Aave; USDC and USDT in Morpho; and USDC USDT in a Prime ALM Proxy. The Core Executor Agent, in consultation with the Stability Facilitators and the Stability Scope Advisors, may impose limitations on the size of exposures to these protocols or to specific pools within these protocols that qualify as Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral in order to prevent excessive risk to Sky.
